title: Practical Semantic Communication for General-Purpose Networks: Compression of High-Dimensional Embeddings Under Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2611.20863v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper introduces a practical framework for semantic communication over wireless channels, focusing on the compression of high-dimensional embeddings under quantization and channel errors. Building upon a relaxed Gaussian Information Bottleneck (GIB) model, the approach provides analytical solutions for task-relevant information preservation, even with non-Gaussian targets. The framework relaxes traditional Gaussian assumptions, enabling effective compression for discrete and complex data such as text embeddings. It derives closed-form gradients for optimizing the compression matrix and establishes bounds linking continuous representations to discrete, noisy system performance. Comprehensive experiments on text classification tasks demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms task-agnostic quantization-based compression methods, maintaining high semantic fidelity at low bit budgets per embedding. translated_title: 面向通用网络的实用语义通信：量化条件下高维嵌入的压缩
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种用于无线信道语义通信的实用框架，重点研究在量化和信道错误条件下高维嵌入的压缩问题。该方法建立在松弛的高斯信息瓶颈模型之上，即使面对非高斯目标也能为任务相关信息的保留提供解析解。该框架放宽了传统的高斯假设，使对文本嵌入等离散和复杂数据的有效压缩成为可能。研究推导了用于优化压缩矩阵的闭式梯度，并建立了将连续表示与离散、含噪系统性能联系起来的理论界限。在文本分类任务上的全面实验表明，所提出的方法优于基于量化的任务无关压缩方法，在每嵌入低比特预算下仍能保持较高的语义保真度。该方法提供了一种可扩展的（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种基于松弛高斯信息瓶颈模型的实用语义通信框架，通过闭式梯度优化压缩矩阵，即使在非高斯的离散数据（如文本嵌入）上也能在低比特预算下实现高保真的任务相关信息压缩。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a practical semantic communication framework based on a relaxed Gaussian Information Bottleneck model, which uses closed-form gradient optimization of the compression matrix to achieve high-fidelity task-relevant compression of low-bit embeddings, even for non-Gaussian discrete data such as text embeddings.
